title: Union Minister Smt. Annpurna Devi Extends Greetings to the Nation on International Tiger Day
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Women and Child Development

Union Minister Smt. Annpurna Devi Extends Greetings to the Nation on International Tiger Day

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
30 JUL 2026 4:25PM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister of Women and Child Development, Smt. Annpurna Devi extended her heartiest greetings and best wishes to the citizens of the country and animal lovers on the occasion of International Tiger Day.

In a post on ‘X’ the Union Minister called upon everyone to make International Tiger Day meaningful by spreading awareness in society about the conservation and promotion of tigers and the preservation of environmental balance.

'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बाघ दिवस' की देश वासियों व पशु प्रेमियों को हार्दिक बधाई एवं शुभकामनाएं।
आइए, बाघों के संरक्षण-संवर्धन और पर्यावरण संतुलन के प्रति समाज में जागरूकता लाकर 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय बाघ दिवस' को सार्थक बनाएं।

— Annpurna Devi (@Annapurna4BJP)
July 29, 2026
